title: Teaching — Adolfo S. Rey B.
metaDescription: Teaching appointment in the Department of Economics at Universidad de los Andes: game theory, microeconomics, industrial organization and macroeconomics.
heading: Teaching
intro: I hold a teaching appointment in the Department of Economics at Universidad de los Andes. As profesor complementario I teach a weekly 90-minute complementary session to a section of the course, and I design and grade most graded coursework, under the course's tenured professor.
notesLink: Class notes for these courses are under Notes.
